$comment: Every difference between text.json and the base witness AS (corrections), and every letter difference of the witnesses from text.json, classified. S is collated anuvāka by anuvāka; Madhva’s text (Mv) vallī by vallī (`at` = the vallī, `near` = the anuvāka where the difference falls), because it divides some anuvākas differently. check.py fails on an unlisted difference or a stale entry. Classes: orthographic · variant · recension · witness-error · review.

corrections.reason: A space inside the word saṃhitā in the base file. The letters are unchanged.
A space inside mahāsaṃhitā in the base file (also in the two places below).
The base file doubles the vowel sign (अथाधििलोकम्); S and Madhva’s text read अथाधिलोकम्, as the parallel अथाधिज्यौतिषम् etc. require.

The base file reads पाहि, ‘protect’, but Śaṅkara’s own gloss explains bhāhi, ‘shine’: «मा मां प्रति प्रभाहि प्रकाशयात्मानम्». S and Madhva’s text read भाहि. The base file’s पाहि is a slip of its mūla; corrected on the evidence of the commentary it accompanies.
य for च in the base file; every other line of the anuvāka has ‘… ca svādhyāyapravacane ca’, and S and Madhva’s text read अग्नयश्च.
The base file breaks the word space inside the anusvāra’s class nasal (सन्तमेन न्ततो for santam enaṃ tato). The letters are unchanged; S and Madhva’s text read सन्तमेनं ततो.
A space inside the word mīmāṃsā in the base file. The letters are unchanged; S reads मीमाँसा.
The last of the ten occurrences of ‘śrotriyasya cākāmahatasya’ is keyed चाकामहातस्य in the base file; the other nine, S and Madhva’s text read चाकामहतस्य.
A space inside the word puruṣavidhatām in the base file (the other four occurrences are written whole). The letters are unchanged; S and Madhva’s text read पुरुषविधताम्.
The base file splits na akaravam as ना करवम्, a space inside the sandhi. The letters are unchanged; S and Madhva’s text read नाकरवम्.
A long ī for short in the base file; the same request reads अधीहि in every other anuvāka and in S and Madhva’s text.
प dropped in the base file; every other anuvāka, S and Madhva’s text read पितरमुपससार.
